limits.initial_device_state: powered_stable; explicit cold_boot case also provided

limitations: Exact DPS310 command acquisition, 8x both channels, no FIFO/interrupts/background mode.
Signed packed trim/ADC and native units judged by independent exact rational polynomial +/-1 target integer unit.
Temperature and pressure are separate conversions; acquired temperature may be reused with no invented one-second expiration.
Stable-input progress within5s is host supervision, not sensor accuracy or manufacturer freshness guarantee.
Vendor workaround exists in original Infineon code; digital effect and affected physical devices are not established. Audit only, omission is not conclusive numeric-failure evidence.
Full trims/ID/factory-source reads are not mandatory traces; actual chosen source and numeric outputs checked.
Successful old acquisitions are not erased by subsequent transport errors.
Before COEF_RDY values are unspecified: such reads explicitly model_unsupported.
Ready flag clear at final channel byte is modeled, not a published stronger byte-level guarantee.
No arbitrary electrical races, physical accuracy, or OS sandbox certification.
